assets.name: The wounded knight
assets.description: Battered armour, a weary silhouette and a believable injured performance.
assets.notes: Keep injury readable through pose, pace and silhouette. Build only the detail the approved cameras need.

tasks.label: Blockout
tasks.description: Approve silhouette, armour, cape and injury references.

tasks.label: Model
tasks.description: Finish visible armour, body, sword and cape geometry.

tasks.label: Materials
tasks.description: Worn steel, cloth and injury detail; check under cave lighting.

tasks.label: Rig
tasks.description: Test shoulder, hip and knee deformation; sword contact.

tasks.label: Motion test
tasks.description: Test injured walk, stumble, breathing and scouting pose.

tasks.label: Scene ready
tasks.description: Approve the character in the cliff approach and reaction cameras.

assets.name: The imprisoned giant
assets.description: A terrifying ancient cook. His cavern is both his home and his eternal prison.
assets.notes: Chains must clearly anchor him to the cave. The cooking ritual should feel familiar and unsettling.

tasks.label: Design
tasks.description: Approve giant silhouette, proportions, face and restraint placement.

tasks.label: Model
tasks.description: Sculpt and prepare body, visible hands, face and shackles.

tasks.label: Materials
tasks.description: Weathered skin and iron; test the orange potion bounce light.

tasks.label: Rig
tasks.description: Rig cooking poses, hand contact and restrained body movement.

tasks.label: Motion test
tasks.description: Test slow stirring, weight shifts, breathing and chain movement.

tasks.label: Scene ready
tasks.description: Approve silhouette and giant scale in the wide reveal.

assets.name: The cavern home
assets.description: A grand interior cliff overlooks a blue-violet cavern, a lived-in home and prison.
assets.notes: The reveal stays inside the cave: ceiling, walls and stalactites frame the giant. Include a sleeping alcove, table and shelves. No open sky.

tasks.label: Design
tasks.description: Approve the cave-home reference, composition and cool/warm palette.

tasks.label: Blockout
tasks.description: Place approach ledge, chasm, troll, pot, cave ceiling and camera path.

tasks.label: Model
tasks.description: Build visible rock formations, home alcoves and prison anchors.

tasks.label: Materials
tasks.description: Rock, damp surfaces, restrained magical accents and domestic materials.

tasks.label: Light test
tasks.description: Blue/purple atmosphere versus orange potion; keep the reveal readable.

tasks.label: Scene ready
tasks.description: Check scale, cave enclosure, depth and all approved camera compositions.

assets.name: Cauldron & restraints
assets.description: The glowing pot, heavy chains and domestic objects that tell the story.
assets.notes: Prioritise cauldron rim, stirring tool, shackles and readable rock anchors. Reuse chain links.

tasks.label: Design
tasks.description: Set pot proportions and chain scale against the giant.

tasks.label: Blockout
tasks.description: Test pot, stirring tool, restraints, table and jars in layout.

tasks.label: Model
tasks.description: Finish camera-visible hero geometry and reusable chain system.

tasks.label: Materials
tasks.description: Aged iron, soot, rough wood and warm reflected potion light.

tasks.label: Scene test
tasks.description: Check hand contact, chain attachment and pot/FX intersections.

tasks.label: Scene ready
tasks.description: Approve props in both wide reveal and close-up cameras.

assets.name: The suspended humans
assets.description: A small set of human silhouettes, slowly carried down the magical spiral.
assets.notes: Use one base with a few pose and clothing variations. Silhouette matters more than small detail; avoid unnecessary gore.

tasks.label: Motion test
tasks.description: Test drifting, rotation and spacing along the spiral.

tasks.label: Scene ready
tasks.description: Approve silhouettes and body/potion transitions in the shot.

assets.name: Magic & atmosphere
assets.description: Violet levitation, thick golden potion and a cold, otherworldly cavern.
assets.notes: Prototype the spiral and potion early. Prefer controllable geometry/shaders to costly simulation where possible.

tasks.label: Reference

tasks.label: Prototype
tasks.description: Build an adjustable spiral path, body drift and potion surface.

tasks.description: Test glow, viscosity, particles and volumetric cave haze.
